en.t: The sky did not grow overcast.

units.source_text: 进入山谷后，类似的淡淡的彩虹好像又出现了。

en.t: After they entered the valley, a similar faint rainbow seemed to appear again.

units.source_text: 但它被清泷川岸边的高山挡住，难以看清楚。

en.t: But it was blocked by the high mountains along the bank of the Kiyotaki River and was hard to see clearly.
